title: adhatoda duvernoia
intro: Adhatoda duvernoia, commonly known as Malabar nut, is a plant species native to India and Southeast Asia, known for its medicinal properties and versatility in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Adhatoda duvernoia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been used to treat various ailments such as bronchitis, asthma, and fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to relax bronchial muscles, reduce inflammation, and act as an expectorant to relieve cough and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Adhatoda duvernoia include vasicine, vasicinone, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are widely used in pharmaceutical and herbal preparations.
